author: Bobby Grayson
description: CPS split implemented in cps_split/6: captured = free vars of the rest that are bound in env. Nested/second blocking calls in the continuation would need recursion into plain_body with a fresh await index; not implemented. Also 'from' is a Lean keyword: added lean_ident sanitizer.
title: Await states are generated St constructors carrying the continuation's free variables; the reply type is a single shared Msg.reply. Limits: one @type reply per program, call must be an assignment statement, continuation cannot itself block (no nested awaits yet)
